rules.headings: Use Instrument Serif with tracking-tight. Keywords inside headings MUST use italic styling for editorial flair.
rules.overlines: Uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, tracking-[0.25em], text-accent_sage.

sizes.hero_h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-normal

visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: Fixed viewport div with subtle SVG noise texture at opacity-5 pointer-events-none z-50
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom magnetic cursor circle that expands and lightens on interactive elements (a, button, cards)
visual_enhancers.grid_lines: Thin 1px vertical/horizontal borders (border-sage/10) with section numbers 01 — 07 in editorial serif
visual_enhancers.alternating_sections: Sections 01-05, 07 dark (#0E1412 / #151D1A); Section 06 Testimonios in warm bone/crema (#EFE9DF) with dark text (#0E1412) for visual cadence

three_js_3d_spine.concept: Abstract glass spine made of 12-16 rounded glass capsules (MeshTransmissionMaterial in Sage green #8FAF9A) with warm copper ambient light highlights.
three_js_3d_spine.scroll_behavior: At initial state (Hero), capsules are misaligned and floating with subtle breathing motion. As user scrolls down, GSAP ScrollTrigger lerps capsule positions into a smooth, aligned S-curve vertebra column.
three_js_3d_spine.performance: DPR capped at 1.5. Wrapped in React Suspense with elegant editorial loader. Simplified geometry or standard MeshPhysicalMaterial on mobile devices.
three_js_3d_spine.particles: Sparse floating micro-particles with low opacity (0.2) in Sage green (#8FAF9A).

motion_rules.text_reveal: Masked line-by-line or word-by-word reveal using Framer Motion / GSAP ScrollTrigger
motion_rules.horizontal_carousel: Section 04 (Experiencia / Casos) pinned horizontal scroll driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger with fine progress bar
motion_rules.timeline_animation: Section 05 (Formación) vertical Sage line that draws down on scroll and lights up nodes when scrolled past
motion_rules.prefers_reduced_motion: Gracefully fallback to static opacity fade-ins when prefers-reduced-motion is true

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL UI elements and content are written in high-quality Spanish as requested.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for high-end feel.
Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for the 3D Spine canvas.
Ensure every interactive element has a proper data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Header navigation MUST be sticky/fixed with glassmorphism backdrop blur.
All contact form interactions directly build a WhatsApp link to https://wa.me/50689846677 with the custom message pre-filled.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always specify target properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always add data-testid attributes to buttons, inputs, links, and key items.
